summary: Highlander Silver Corp. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 press release reporting a courtesy meeting between company executives and Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori and Energy and Mines Minister Guillermo Shinno in Lima on October 6, 2026. The release touts the Corani Silver Project, community infrastructure sharing, and job access; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. Major shareholders named include the Augusta Group, Lundin family, and Eric Sprott. This is a routine disclosure, not a special situation, so no risk-arb angle exists; watch only for future project or financing news.
